## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. E.g. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

> If this request involves changing the shape of `spec/schemas/*.schema.json` or a catalog record, please use the **Schema/catalog change proposal** template instead so the proposal captures breaking-change and catalog-impact details.
